title: Centralise shape creation in a factory
description: ShapeFactory receives a type string and dimensions, and is expected to return the matching Shape — but the implementation is missing. The concrete shape classes (Circle, Rectangle, Triangle) already exist.
hints: Create a class called ShapeFactory with a static create(String type, double... args) method
Use a switch statement on the type string to decide which shape to instantiate
Throw an IllegalArgumentException for unknown types
issues: Every caller that needs a shape contains its own if/else block
Adding a new shape type means updating every call site
goals: Create a ShapeFactory class with a static create() method
All branching logic lives in one place
Callers no longer need to know which class to instantiate
